lead_fa: Subtlety اسپک کول‌داون‌محور راگ است: همهٔ دمیجت داخل پنجره‌های کوتاه و سنگین هر 90 ثانیه می‌نشیند و امضایش [[Shadow Dance]] است. با تلنت [[Shadow Techniques]] اقتصاد منابع به اتواک گره خورده و همهٔ کول‌داون‌ها روی [[Secret Technique]] هم‌تراز می‌شوند. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Trickster]] با [[Coup de Grace]] که با تغییرهای اخیر بهترین انتخاب در همهٔ موقعیت‌هاست، و [[Deathstalker]] با [[Deathstalker's Mark]] که روی کاغذ تک‌هدفش حدود 2% جلوتر ولی سخت‌تر است.

strengths: Strong burst damage windows every 90 seconds
Fast-paced playstyle during cooldowns and a simple rotation
weaknesses: Weak cleave damage; both hero trees lack cleave

buffs: Subtlety received a 14% compensation buff to offset the damage loss from fixed interactions
changes_12_1.note: 12.1.5: multiple Shadow damage interactions were reworked; Shadow clone attacks now work reliably with Clone damage events and spells only benefit from damage amplifiers one time instead of multiple. Lots of invisible changes: performance should stay unchanged but talent suggestions may shift over time.

hero.recommendation: The currently recommended hero is Trickster in all situations: outstanding burst damage, good AoE, similar single target and easier to play. Deathstalker is competitive and marginally better on pure single target (roughly 2%), with its main advantage being higher priority target damage in multi-target situations; the downside is a more difficult rotation. Play Trickster everywhere and only consider Deathstalker when the priority damage profile is an advantage.
hero.trickster: Focuses on improving damage during cooldowns while adding a frequent, stronger finishing move with Coup de Grace. Utility: Don't Be Suspicious reduces Shroud of Concealment's cooldown and So Tricky extends Tricks of the Trade to one hour.
hero.deathstalker: Focuses on single-target and sustained damage through Deathstalker's Mark, which is also its biggest downside: moving the mark between targets is manual via Mark for Death and creates mental overhead. Slightly better defensives (Ethereal Cloak, Bait and Switch) and utility via Shadewalker and Shroud of Night.
hero.comparison_source_note: Wowhead overview and talent page: Trickster is the best option in all situations with recent changes; Deathstalker ~2% ahead on pure single target with harder rotation.

concepts: Resource economy: Energy and Combo Point income is low outside cooldowns and high during; Shadow Techniques makes staying within auto attack range essential
Cooldown management: align all cooldowns to Secret Technique; use Shadow Dance twice with Shadow Blades and delay slightly when Blades is about to come off cooldown
GCD efficiency: never cast Shadow Dance during a global; Deepening Shadows can extend Dance just enough for another spell, so use a macro combining the cooldown with a builder or spender
A builder-and-spender core: finish at 6 or 7 combo points; Energy is the limiting resource and feeling resource-starved is normal
Concentrate as much damage as possible into cooldown windows
st_priority: During Shadow Dance: use finishers at 6 or more combo points, casting Secret Technique first, then Eviscerate; build with Shadowstrike
Outside Shadow Dance: use finishers at 6 or more combo points casting Eviscerate; build with Backstab
Use Shadow Dance with 6 or more combo points when Secret Technique is ready or during Shadow Blades
Use Shadow Blades if you have Shadow Dance ready
Use Goremaw's Bite on cooldown before Shadow Dance
Use Vanish on cooldown with low combo points

Outside Shadow Dance: use finishers at 6 or more combo points casting Eviscerate; build with Backstab
Use Shadow Dance with low combo points when Darkest Night is up or Secret Technique is ready
Use Shadow Blades if you have Shadow Dance ready
Use Goremaw's Bite on cooldown before Shadow Dance
Use Vanish on cooldown with low combo points

Outside Shadow Dance: use finishers at 6 or more combo points casting Eviscerate with Coup de Grace then Black Powder; build with Shuriken Storm
Use Shadow Dance with 6 or more combo points when Secret Technique is ready or during Shadow Blades
Use Shadow Blades if you have Shadow Dance ready

Use Vanish on cooldown with low combo points
rotation.aoe_note: Subtlety switches to a multi-target rotation already with two or more targets, replacing single-target builders and finishers with multi-target options. Hero and Apex talents impact these decisions, potentially leading to the use of single-target spells.

cooldowns.Secret Technique: A finishing move split into three parts and the only Subtlety cooldown with a static cooldown reduced by Haste; the initial hit is physical while the second and third hits are Shadow damage that count as Clone Attacks (Replicating Shadows works with them); soft target capped at 5 targets; optimal use is as soon as possible, ideally during Shadow Dance, to get as many Disorienting Strikes procs as possible
cooldowns.Shadow Dance: The defining cooldown of Subtlety: allows Stealth-specific spells for its duration; cannot be used while in Stealth; macros combining it with Shadowstrike are common; use twice with Shadow Blades, the second instance without Secret Technique unless you have Bloodlust
cooldowns.Shadow Blades: A 90-second cooldown that doubles the combo point generation of your builders and echoes 20% of the damage dealt during its uptime as Shadow damage; its cooldown is reset with encounters
cooldowns.Goremaw's Bite: Used on cooldown before Shadow Dance; the talent must be taken to reach Lingering Darkness and is required to be played

rotation.hero_notes: With Deathstalker, keep an eye on Deathstalker's Mark: certain events and encounter phase switches can remove it, so use Mark for Death when that happens; cycling the mark should align naturally but Quietus Celeris procs can misalign it, which Vanish can solve. Both heroes optimize around Ancient Arts during Shadow Dance, and you can stop using finishers a few seconds before Secret Technique comes off cooldown. With Trickster the advised macro is Secret Technique + Shadow Dance to fight the Haste problem of Deepening Shadows.
dance_sequence_default: Shadow Dance + Shuriken Storm (or Goremaw's Bite) for Ancient Arts
Shadowstrike (only with 5+ stacks of Shadow Techniques)
Secret Technique; start this sequence with Darkest Night up
opener: Make sure to be in Stealth before pull
Use your trinket (Voracious Heart of Ula'tek)
Cast Shuriken Storm, then Secret Technique
Repeat Shadowstrike and Eviscerate for the rest of Shadow Dance
rotation.opener_notes: Slice and Dice is usually passively maintained through Cut to the Chase; using Eviscerate to apply it might be needed in multi target situations during the opener.
pre_combat: Use Instant Poison as your lethal poison and Atrophic Poison as your utility poison (only reapply if about to run out)

gear.gearing_rules: Stat priority follows Mastery > Haste >= Versatility = Critical Strike and applies to both Deathstalker and Trickster. Strong trinkets and special effects on head, neck and dagger concentrate most of the best options, so most gear comes from the last two bosses of the raid. Upgrade priorities with Mistcrests: 1) main-hand weapon (weapon damage is the biggest scalar of ability damage), 2) strong trinkets, 3) special effect items (Gaze of the Coiled Watcher and Aqirbane Reliquary: upgrading increases stat budget and the damage effect), 4) lowest item level pieces. Sim with Raidbots.

tier_set.name: Chosen Bloodslayer's Hexweave
tier_set.note: 2pc: Backstab costs 10 less Energy and has 100% increased damage; Shuriken Storm costs 5 less Energy and has 60% increased damage. 4pc: Lingering Shadow now also benefits Eviscerate and Black Powder at 100% effectiveness.

stats.cheatsheet: Mastery > Haste >= Versatility = Critical Strike after Agility for both heroes. Mythic+ and add-heavy fights invest the majority of the stat budget into Mastery. Haste has no hard cap but around 700 Haste is the rule of thumb to fit one more global inside Shadow Dance.
notes: Single Target Deathstalker order: Agility > Mastery > Haste (~700) > Versatility > Critical Strike.
Single Target Trickster order: Agility > Mastery > Haste (~700) > Critical Strike > Versatility.
The 700 Haste value is a rule of thumb, not a hard limit; stat procs from folio, special effect gear, weapon enchants, embellishments and trinkets can lower it.
stats.per_hero_or_mode: Deathstalker swaps Versatility and Critical Strike at positions 4-5 versus Trickster; Mythic+ invests mostly into Mastery.

mplus.hero_note: Trickster is the recommendation in all situations: outstanding burst, good AoE and easier to play. Subtlety switches to the multi-target rotation already at two or more targets, so Shuriken Storm and Black Powder drive AoE while Secret Technique stays the aligning cooldown.
tips: Stay within auto attack range: Shadow Techniques funds your resources, especially outside cooldowns
Align Secret Technique and Shadow Dance; delay both slightly when Shadow Blades is about to come off cooldown
Use Shuriken Storm as the builder and Black Powder as the spender once two or more targets are present
In AoE use Secret Technique with Supercharger in the first two finishers of Dance and with Ancient Arts on 4 or more targets
Macro Secret Technique with Shadow Dance (Trickster) so Deepening Shadows extensions are never wasted on a global delay
